findings.title: Orders endpoint lacks tenant predicate
findings.exploit_scenario: A user in tenant A requests an order id from tenant B and receives it because the query filters on id alone.
evidence: src/orders/get.ts:L33 SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = $1

fix.summary: Add tenant predicate and row-level security

regression_test.description: Two-tenant test expects 404 for a foreign order id

findings.residual_risk: Sibling endpoints need the same review.

findings.title: Webhook replay window may be too wide
findings.unresolved_fact: Whether the processed_events table has a UNIQUE constraint on event id in the production schema.

findings.title: Admin route reachable without auth
findings.rejection_reason: Route is behind the fallback authorization policy (Program.cs:L18) and covered by tests.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
findings.exploit_scenario: No exploit path found; header would reduce browser feature exposure if another flaw appears.
